text_566c957cf572: In the route editor, Delete removes your own saved route after separate confirmation. Imported knowledge and GPS originals are retained. To transfer GPS, choose a finished own recording from the list. Only selected GPS recording hides other knowledge traces; M1 points and your current selection remain visible. Draw the complete course along the light-blue trace using M1 points and choose Valid until (at most one year). Save explicitly confirms qualified manual knowledge. The saved row then offers Remove GPS original. Saving alone removes nothing. Before confirmation, the server checks that the route covers all reliable GPS positions in a 200-metre corridor and that neither the recording nor the saved route has changed. Active recordings and unsent local changes block cleanup. Only your second confirmation removes the raw-point list from the server and this device. Linked GPS demos are revoked. The compact route and existing duty and train details remain. Other devices or your exports may still hold copies. Removed raw points cannot be restored, even after deleting the compact route later. These verified deletions require a connection to the updated server.
